headline: Four unbeaten sides win eleven of thirteen
dek: AUM, Trevecca and UAH have won all nine of their matches, and Lee have drawn two of four without losing. The other seven programmes have won three matches between them and lost thirteen of the twenty-one they have played.
displaced_by: Lee's win over Tusculum gives a second programme two wins, so 'no other programme has won more than once' no longer holds; four sides are now unbeaten.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring at the top is not one striker's doing: UAH's ten goals have come from seven different players.

wire.line: West Alabama have conceded ten goals, more than any other programme, and have yet to win.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches have passed their date with no result at all, the earliest Trevecca's at Belmont, and no final has been left without a score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Every published result now has a box score behind it; the gap behind Union's defeat to Kentucky Wesleyan has been closed.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lee are unbeaten, with two wins and two draws, and have conceded two goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Delta State have scored once all season, Tazjean Bird's goal at Harding, and that was the match they won.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Charles Carriglitto has kept clean sheets in two of Lee's four matches.

last_match.line: Lee remain the only unbeaten side that has drawn a match.

next_match.line: Union have yet to win; Christian Brothers have already won at Harding.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
